reviewer: Codex agent native gameplay screenshot review
scope: Continuous aged rectangular paving without stone-image pads; grass in authored mortar joints, purposeful planting, building-zone curbs, house bases and rounded trees

criteria.criterion: Continuous aged rectangular road without overlapping stone-image pads
criteria.evidence: Native avenue capture: one consistent stone scale and joint pattern; former small white stone islands absent.

criteria.criterion: Curb bounds the building-side zone; planted margins and private house bases belong to the adjoining lots
criteria.evidence: Raised curbs remain along the street boundary. Private plinths/aprons anchor the houses; edge grass and planted shop displays sit inside building-side space.

criteria.criterion: Weathered facades, private bases and accessories remain readable; the foreground house reveals the player
criteria.evidence: Recessed windows, projecting timber, flower boxes, sills, doors and plinths remain visible. Home capture records faded owner frontage-riverside and a visible player.

criteria.criterion: City material detail remains consistent at native resolution
criteria.evidence: Roof tiles, dressed masonry, timber, awnings and paving retain readable detail. Remaining untextured native materials are intentional light/fire colors, independently checked in city-detail-check.json.

criteria.criterion: Trees have full crowns and readable leaf/bark detail without oversized crossing geometry
criteria.evidence: Bowed leaf layers and rounded tops read as crowns. Visible extents stay within the preceding canopy bounds verified in tree-crown-check.json; existing roots and collisions are retained.

criteria.criterion: Tiered planted fountain retains its construction and material detail in the coherent paving context
criteria.evidence: Raised stone basin, sculpted central statue, flowing water, four formal beds and surrounding benches remain readable. Court stones share the same scale as adjoining walks.

limitations: Scoped agent screenshot review does not imply user Golden acceptance.
Screenshot fixtures do not prove traversal; ordinary-input services and field transition are verified separately.
Visual pass does not imply FPS acceptance or physical-device certification.
